cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Delegate Downward
cards.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As junior coordinator, you're responsible for the blocked sink. Book a plumber, please, not another volunteer with a coat hanger.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ran the whole event yesterday. You said I'd earned a promotion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To senior coordinator. You still report to me; now you can supervise the plumber instead of merely booking him.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He can only come after everyone leaves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then keep the keys and lock up afterward. Check every exit, please. I shouldn't have to leave you a junior's checklist.

reason: Correct inverted above-grade phrase; professional rank correction now explicitly assigns B broader subordinate duty, and final pressure requests competent lockup.
